intro: Salt-Brined Pickles at CAVA add a crisp, tangy burst to any bowl or pita without adding extra calories or cost. These cucumber pickles are traditionally brined in salt water, delivering authentic Mediterranean flavor to complement the [full CAVA menu](/). At just 5 calories and included free with every order, they are a guilt-free way to enhance your meal.
priceCalories: Salt-Brined Pickles are included free with any CAVA order and contain only 5 calories per serving. With 0g protein, 0g carbs, and 0g fat, they provide pure flavor without impacting your macros. This makes them an ideal addition whether you are building a custom bowl from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or ordering from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Salt-Brined Pickles apart is their traditional preparation using simple salt water brine instead of vinegar-heavy solutions. This method creates a clean, crisp taste that enhances rather than overpowers other ingredients. The authentic Mediterranean brining technique preserves the cucumber's natural crunch while developing complex, tangy flavors that complement the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) offerings perfectly.
nutritionFacts: With a nutritional profile of just 5 calories and zero grams of protein, carbohydrates, and fat, Salt-Brined Pickles are one of the lightest options available. They provide flavor and texture without adding significant nutritional content, making them perfect for those tracking macros or calories. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how they fit into your complete meal plan.
whatsInside: Salt-Brined Pickles contain only two simple ingredients: fresh cucumbers and salt water brine. This minimalist approach ensures a clean ingredient list free from artificial preservatives, colors, or flavors. The traditional brining process naturally ferments the cucumbers, creating probiotics while maintaining their signature crunch. For allergen details, visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) to ensure they fit your dietary needs.
tasteLike: These pickles deliver a bright, tangy flavor with a satisfying crunch that cuts through rich, creamy elements. The salt brine creates a clean, sharp taste that is less acidic than vinegar-based pickles, allowing the natural cucumber flavor to shine. They add refreshing contrast to savory proteins and creamy dips, creating balance in every bite of your CAVA bowl or pita.
customize: Add Salt-Brined Pickles to any custom creation from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) or pair them with other fresh toppings like Shredded Romaine, Tomato + Onion, or Sumac Cabbage Slaw. They work beautifully in both hot and cold bowls, complementing everything from grilled proteins to plant-based options. Layer them strategically for maximum flavor impact throughout your meal.
pairsWell: Salt-Brined Pickles pair exceptionally well with rich spreads from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus or tzatziki, providing tangy contrast. They complement creamy dressings, grilled chicken, falafel, and lamb meatballs perfectly. Try them with Pita Crisps for added texture, or alongside Tomato + Onion and Shredded Romaine for a refreshing vegetable medley that balances heavier ingredients.
healthyChoice: At only 5 calories with no fat, carbs, or protein, Salt-Brined Pickles are an exceptionally healthy topping choice. They add flavor and satisfaction without compromising dietary goals, making them perfect for low-calorie, keto, and low-carb diets. The traditional fermentation process may also provide beneficial probiotics, supporting digestive health while you enjoy delicious Mediterranean flavors guilt-free.
howToOrder: Simply select Salt-Brined Pickles from the toppings section when building your custom bowl or pita at CAVA. They are automatically included at no extra charge with every order. Add them after your base, protein, and dips for optimal layering, or request them on the side. They are available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) nationwide.
vsAlternatives: Compared to other toppings like Sumac Cabbage Slaw at 30 calories or Tomato + Onion at 20 calories, Salt-Brined Pickles offer the most flavor for the fewest calories. Unlike vinegar-based pickles, these use traditional salt-brining for a cleaner taste. While Pita Crisps add 70 calories of crunch, pickles deliver texture without the extra calories, making them ideal for calorie-conscious diners.
whoShouldTry: Salt-Brined Pickles are perfect for pickle lovers, anyone watching calories or macros, and those seeking authentic Mediterranean flavors. They suit keto, low-carb, vegan, and gluten-free diets beautifully. If you enjoy tangy, crunchy elements that add brightness to meals, these pickles are essential. Visit the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) to explore more compatible options for your dietary preferences.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying, Salt-Brined Pickles add restaurant-quality flavor to your CAVA experience without any downside. At zero cost and minimal calories, there is no reason not to include them. They transform ordinary bowls into extraordinary meals with authentic Mediterranean tang and crunch. Whether you are a pickle enthusiast or simply seeking balanced flavors, these are a smart, delicious addition.
